name: Ezra
desc:
Ezra is a Capra NPC.

Ezra gives a quest to kill Songseekers at the [Derelict Highchurch](location:derelict_highchurch). He also provides some information about Songseekers. Upon completing his quest, you gain a Bravery Talent hand.

Before [Samael](entity:samael) and the Starkindred took over the [Derelict Highchurch](location:derelict_highchurch), it was a place for Ezra and the Capra to worship Mother Ku, a Celestial. When [Samael](entity:samael) took over, he turned it into a place to "worship" an unknown Celestial.

The quest and Talent hand is unavailable if you are a Starkindred.
